name: mpl
description: Pure-JavaScript, zero-dependency reproduction of matplotlib's output (SVG and PNG), verified against matplotlib itself
author: Ivar Vong <ivar@ivarvong.com>

scripts.examples: for f in examples/[a-z]*.ts; do node $f || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:oracle
scripts.test:oracle: node test/compare.ts && node test/libm.test.ts && node test/libm-equiv.test.ts && node test/fonts.test.ts && node test/fontcodec.test.ts && node test/lean-core.test.ts && node test/png.test.ts && node --expose-gc --test test/png-mem.test.ts && node test/png-palette.test.ts && node test/glyphcache.test.ts && node test/conic.test.ts && node test/view.test.ts && node test/fuzz-ticker.ts && node test/fuzz-dates.ts && node test/fuzz-rrule-dates.ts && node test/dates-api.test.ts && node test/hidpi.test.ts && node test/rgba-out.test.ts && node test/trace.test.ts && node test/rc-svg.test.ts && node test/layout-cache.test.ts && node test/tight-measure.test.ts && node test/issue7.test.ts && node test/issue14.test.ts && node test/grid.test.ts && node test/histogram.test.ts && node test/boxplot.test.ts && node test/colorbar.test.ts && node test/colorbar-axes.test.ts && node test/title.test.ts && node test/arrowstyle.test.ts && node test/linestyle.test.ts && node test/plots.test.ts && node test/colormap.test.ts && node test/pro-styles.test.ts && node test/colormap-rgba.test.ts && node test/api-docs.test.ts && node test/examples.test.ts && node test/svg-xml.test.ts && node test/nan-svg.test.ts && node test/decimate.test.ts && node test/svg-precision.test.ts && node test/svg-geometry.test.ts && node test/svg-collection.test.ts && node test/annotate.test.ts && node test/invert.test.ts && node test/replay-dates.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run strict && npm run lint
scripts.lint: oxlint src test tools scripts bench examples --ignore-pattern tools/live/lib/**
scripts.fuzz: python3 fixtures/fuzz_ticker.py && python3 fixtures/fuzz_dates.py && python3 fixtures/fuzz_rrule_dates.py && node test/fuzz-ticker.ts && node test/fuzz-dates.ts && node test/fuzz-rrule-dates.ts
